page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes on both the left and right. Top: running head and page number. Below the text, a heading block (QVAESTIO, the title, the author line and the date). Then questions and answers with speaker names, subheads and numbered paragraphs. Left-margin notes at the top and at the heading. Right-margin line numbers (5 to 60) beside the text. Catchword at lower right.

nec propositionem vllam erroneam maleuoli in ea quam impugnauerant epistola, neque in
Commentario contra paruas datas, annotare poterant: sed collationem omnem detrectantes,
inauditum hominem clamoribus stentoreis opprimere conabantur.
* Neque sanctioris consilii decretum, neq; diplomata patentia, pro more significata, qui-
bus summa Curia manum admouere recusauit, aduersariorum effrenis potentia, factiones &
artes adeo inualuerunt, vt auctor regno excedere coactus sit. Inseruit autem iunioris Hassiae
Landgrauio, cuius nomine obtinuit cunctas ditiones, vrbes, arces & dominia, quibus pater e-
ius Philippus, Camerae imperialis arrestis tribus, dum captiuus viueret, pronuntiatis grauatus,
tandem spoliatus fuerat. His peractis auctor in Franciam reuertsus est, vt se regi, quem ex
bellica profectione reuersum esse nouerat, sisteret. Sed Cardinalium & Pontificiorum technis
auctor longius quam antea in Germania latebras captare coactus, Principibus regis Franciae
confoederatis operam suam accommodauit, lautissimis stipendiis quae Regis Romanorum
aliorumque Principum nomine ei deferebantur constanter repudiatis.

page.notes: Running head and page number read clearly. Marginal numerals 5 to 60 on the right were taken as line numbers and entered as notes at the nearest paragraph; their exact placement is approximate. Left-margin note at the second paragraph: first word of the note, "Quaestā-", is doubtful and marked [?]. Left note beside the title: "Anno 1570." Word "inauditum" at the line break ("ina-/auditum") is read as printed but the hyphenation is doubtful. Printed "debeti" at the end of the last paragraph is left as printed (probably a misprint for debere). "acen-satores" is left as printed with its hyphen. Greek and Hebrew: none on this page. Blocks not present: no signature, no second page, no catchword other than "Ad".
